newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris air freight body (CIF) to meet on Oct 18.
newsitem.headline: Paris air freight body (CIF) to meet on Oct 18.

text.p: The Comite Interprofessionel du Fret (CIF), a steering group set up by the air cargo community at the Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle and Orly, is to hold its next executive committee meeting on October 18, a CIF official said.

CIF's executve committee comprises representatives from France's air freight forwarding agents, SNAGFA, airlines, customs and the Paris airport authority's freight marketing department, he told Reuters.

Among the topics on the meeting's agenda will be a review of work undertaken by CIF's five commissions - freight services, quality, logistics, customs and information technology, he added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
